## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Why is the current behavior not enough?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you would like GuildForge to do. Include the command or flag you imagine:

```text
guildforge ...
```

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or other approaches you tried.

## Scope check

GuildForge intentionally never copies: messages, members, webhooks, integrations,
bot configurations, or member-specific permission overwrites. Does your request
fit within the structure-copying scope?

- [ ] This request stays within structure copying (roles, channels, overwrites, settings, emojis/stickers).

## Additional context

Screenshots, sample JSON, or output that helps explain the idea.
